note: Hand (GX16) only. Not copied: EX16 exoskeleton, retargeting, teleop, ZMQ transport, Viser viewers, GeoRT. The driver is gx4m_real.robot.hand: same motor registers and angle convention as GEX16 src/gx16.py and src/motor.py (URDF deg = (present position deg - 90) * JOINT_MOTOR_DIRECTIONS), with group sync read/write instead of per-motor transactions.
